voice.register.value: warm, direct expert voice that speaks to the client as "you"

voice.sample.value: You don't have to know everything. We'll prepare a complete design of your interior with a shopping list, so you know what to buy and how it all works together.

notes.name: We took the name from the site description; it matches the lettering in the logo.
notes.logo: We used the logo from the site header as it is; it sits well on a light page, and in dark mode its green is lightened.
notes.tone: We write warmly and plainly, speak to the client as "you" and take the weight of decisions off them, drawing on experience.
